title: Submit a strata scheme annual report
summary: Learn how to submit a strata scheme annual report online through the Strata Hub portal.
intro:
All strata schemes in NSW need to report online each year through NSW Fair Trading’s Strata Hub portal within 3 months of their Annual General Meeting (AGM).

Fines may apply if schemes don’t meet their reporting requirements.

If you’re responsible for submitting a strata scheme annual report, you’ll need to register for the Strata Hub portal and set up a profile.
who_can_apply: A strata committee member (such as the secretary, chairperson, or treasurer) of the owners corporation
what_you_need: Login details for the Strata Hub portal
Individual or corporation licence details (if you are a strata manager)

how_to_steps.text: Select the ‘Submit an annual report’ button.
Log in to the Strata Hub portal with the username and password you created when you registered.
Follow the prompts to complete your annual reporting, including making your payment (using credit or debit card, BPAY, PayPal or PayID).

more_info.text: There is an annual reporting fee, payable per lot.

faqs.q: When must a strata scheme submit its annual report?
faqs.a: All strata schemes in NSW must report online through NSW Fair Trading’s Strata Hub portal within 3 months of their Annual General Meeting (AGM).

faqs.q: Who can submit the strata scheme annual report?
faqs.a: A strata committee member (such as the secretary, chairperson, or treasurer) or the appointed strata manager can submit the report.

faqs.q: What is needed to submit the annual report?
faqs.a: You will need a MyService NSW account, your Strata Hub portal login details, information about the strata scheme, your licence details (if you are a strata manager), and payment.
